# Assumption of Moses Chapter 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Joshua's Lament Over Moses

---

**1** When Joshua had heard all these things, he tore his garments and fell at Moses' feet and began to weep for him, saying:

**2** O Moses, why have you tried to comfort me? How can I go on without you?

**3** Who will feed this vast multitude? Who will be their shepherd?

**4** Who will have compassion on them and lead them in the right way?

**5** Who will pray for them when they sin and make intercession on their behalf?

**6** Behold, the land will be distributed to them, and they will set their hearts on good things.

**7** But when they are in the land they will sin and will not keep the commandments of the Lord, just as their fathers did.

**8** And who will intercede for them and ask forgiveness for their sins?

**9** For their God will be angry with them and will not spare them.

**10** He will uproot them from the land and scatter them among the nations.

**11** How then will they survive among the nations? They will not rule over them.

**12** How will they be able to cry out to the Lord their God, the Most High who holds all power?

**13** How will they be able to remain in the land if there is no one to plead for them?

**14** For you are about to leave us, and where will those who fear God turn for comfort?

**15** For what nation will not celebrate on hearing of your departure and say: let us rise up and destroy them from the face of the earth?

**16** For Moses, the holy prophet and servant of God, has gone from among them.
